#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

int gcd(int a, int b) {
    while (b) {
        int t = b;
        b = a % b;
        a = t;
    }
    return a;
}

int main() {
    int x, y, limit;
    scanf("%d %d %d", &x, &y, &limit);
    
    double best_diff = 1e9;
    int best_num = 0, best_den = 1;
    
    double target = (double)x / y;
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= limit; i++) {
        int b = (long long)x * i / y;
        
        for (int num : {b-1, b, b+1}) {
            if (num < 0) continue;
            double diff = fabs(target - (double)num / i);
            if (diff < best_diff || (diff == best_diff && num < best_num)) {
                best_diff = diff;
                best_num = num;
                best_den = i;
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (fabs(1.0 - target) <= best_diff + 1e-9) {
        best_num = 1;
        best_den = 1;
    }
    
    int g = gcd(best_num, best_den);
    printf("%d/%d\n", best_num / g, best_den / g);
    
    return 0;
}
